answer: Each epoch a key's bidding capacity falls to zero, and haven verifiers refill it only after timing challenges that measure the drift of the quartz oscillator answering for it. Keys whose replies trace one quartz drift curve run on one machine, and each must burn copper equal to the number of keys sharing that crystal. An honest agent burns 1 copper per epoch. An operator running 100 clones on one host burns 10,000 copper every epoch, or must buy and power 100 separate machines whose crystals haven can tell apart.
